steps.message: I’ll update the local Maven dependency metadata first, then build against `org.eclipse.jdt.core` 3.40.0 and fix any production-code breakages without touching tests.

todos.content: Locate Maven manifests and current org.eclipse.jdt.core version
Apply dependency bump to 3.40.0 and regenerate metadata if required
Build/test compile project to identify upgrade breakages
Patch production source for JDT 3.40.0 compatibility
